test-set.name: seqtor-boundaries

test-case.name: seqtor-148
test-case.description: Whitespace-only select body fails a required singleton result type.

test-case.name: seqtor-149
test-case.description: Multiple select results fail a required singleton result type.

test-case.description: Select body can return a callable ordinary function item.

test-case.name: seqtor-151
test-case.description: Select body preserves XML-node identity and explicit reverse order.

test-case.description: Host xpath-default-namespace applies to select body name tests.

test-case.description: A selected expression error propagates rather than invoking fallback.
